issues.problem: tameni-purpose contrast (のに) called 使う, 便利, 必要, かかる 'evaluative words'; 使う and かかる are not evaluative.
issues.action: Reworded to 'words of use, need or cost such as 使う, 便利, 必要, かかる'.

issues.problem: x-tameni-youni explain called ないために 'stiff and uncommon'; purpose ないために (忘れないために) is in common use.
issues.action: Changed to 'ないために also occurs, but ように is the default choice'.

issues.problem: uchi-ni explain listed only ている / ない verb forms before うちに, leaving out the very common state verbs (日本にいるうちに).
issues.action: Added 'or a state verb such as いる: 日本にいるうちに'.

issues.problem: maeni-atode explain implied あと without で is followed only by a state or a stretch of time; 食べた後、薬を飲んだ is also normal.
issues.action: Reworded: あと alone is also common, and is the natural choice when a state or stretch of time follows.
